# Rugby Campus

> A free guide to US college rugby programs for aspiring players: CRAA D1A and NCR D1 programs, mapped and tiered, with coach contacts and plain-English recruitment guides. Built by Hugh Johnston, an Australian who played, captained and then coached Notre Dame College to the 2023 NCR D1 National Championship.

Rugby Campus is independent. It is not affiliated with USA Rugby, CRAA or NCR. It is free for players. Revenue comes from paid one-on-one coaching and featured program listings for colleges (always labelled Featured).

## Core pages
- [All programs, tiered](https://www.rugbycampus.org/colleges): Tier 1 (strongest) to Tier 4
- [Interactive map](https://www.rugbycampus.org/map)
- [Best rugby colleges in America guide](https://www.rugbycampus.org/learn/best-rugby-colleges-usa)
- [Why college rugby rankings lie](https://www.rugbycampus.org/learn/why-college-rugby-rankings-lie)
- [When college rugby programs die](https://www.rugbycampus.org/learn/when-college-rugby-programs-die)
- [How to play rugby in college in the USA](https://www.rugbycampus.org/learn/how-to-play-rugby-college-usa)
- [Rugby scholarships in the USA explained](https://www.rugbycampus.org/learn/rugby-scholarships-explained)
- [How college rugby recruitment works](https://www.rugbycampus.org/learn/how-college-rugby-recruitment-works)
- [Training](https://www.rugbycampus.org/training)
- [About Hugh](https://www.rugbycampus.org/about)
- [For college coaches](https://www.rugbycampus.org/for-coaches)

## Full data
- [llms-full.txt](https://www.rugbycampus.org/llms-full.txt): every program with affiliation, conference, squad size, and MLR draft and playing numbers (drafted and played are counted separately)
- [sitemap.xml](https://www.rugbycampus.org/sitemap.xml)
